title: Software Engineer (SDE)
description: Design, code and test software applications. Strong programming fundamentals, data structures and algorithms, object oriented programming, databases and version control. Solves problems and writes clean, efficient code.

title: Python Developer
description: Build backend services and automation scripts in Python. Develop REST APIs with Django, Flask or FastAPI, work with relational databases and write tests.

title: Java Developer
description: Develop enterprise backend applications in Java using Spring Boot. Build REST APIs and microservices, work with SQL databases and write unit tests.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Build responsive, accessible user interfaces for websites and web apps using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern frameworks like React.

title: Backend Developer (Node.js)
description: Build server-side applications and APIs with Node.js and Express, design databases, handle authentication and deploy services.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Develop complete web applications covering frontend interfaces and backend APIs and databases, using stacks like MERN or Django with React.

title: Android Developer
description: Build Android mobile applications using Kotlin or Java, integrate APIs and Firebase, and publish apps to the Play Store.

title: Data Analyst
description: Collect, clean and analyse business data using SQL, Excel and Python, build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, and present insights to stakeholders.

title: Data Scientist
description: Use statistics and machine learning to solve business problems: explore data, engineer features, build predictive models and communicate results.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Train, evaluate and deploy machine learning and deep learning models into production systems, with data pipelines and model monitoring.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build natural language processing systems such as text classification, named entity recognition, search and chatbots using transformers and large language models.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develop image and video analysis systems: object detection, image classification and segmentation using deep learning and OpenCV.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build and maintain data pipelines and warehouses, process large datasets with Spark, schedule workflows and ensure data quality.

title: Business Analyst
description: Understand business needs, gather requirements, analyse processes and data, and communicate recommendations to stakeholders and technical teams.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate build, test and deployment pipelines, manage cloud infrastructure, containerise applications and monitor production systems.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Design, deploy and support applications on cloud platforms like AWS and Azure, manage compute, storage and networking resources.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor and protect systems and networks, investigate security incidents, run vulnerability assessments and recommend fixes.

title: QA / Test Engineer
description: Test software manually and with automation, write test cases, report bugs and work with developers to ship quality products.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Research user needs and design intuitive interfaces: wireframes, prototypes and visual designs for web and mobile products.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description: Help customers resolve technical issues with software, hardware and networks, troubleshoot problems and document solutions.

title: Database Administrator / SQL Developer
description: Write and optimise SQL queries, design database schemas, manage backups and performance for relational databases.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description: Program microcontrollers and embedded devices in C, build IoT prototypes and work with hardware interfaces and real-time systems.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description: Plan and run online marketing campaigns across search, social media and email, improve SEO and track performance with analytics.

title: Content Writer
description: Write clear, engaging content for websites, blogs and social media, research topics and optimise articles for search engines.

title: HR Associate / Recruiter
description: Source and screen candidates, coordinate interviews, maintain employee records and support HR operations.
